title: nte-shoe-foot-motion
summary: Analyze and reproduce NTE high-heel or loose-shoe motion relative to the foot using separate Toe0, Foot and calf skin weights. Use for walking/running heel lift, shoe-foot separation, rigid soles and ankle-strap deformation. Distinguish skinning from visibility toggles, animation clips and physics; not a general shoe-fitting or outfit-toggle skill.
